mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, u.email, u.password, u.name, u.role_code, r.name AS role_name, u.company_id, c.name AS company_name, u.created_at, u.updated_at FROM users u JOIN companies c ON u.company_id = c.company_id JOIN roles r ON u.role_code = r.role_code WHERE u.company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY u.user_id;

SELECT u.user_id, u.email, u.password, u.name, r.name AS role_name, u.role_code, u.company_id, c.name AS company_name, u.created_at, u.updated_at FROM users u JOIN companies c ON u.company_id = c.company_id JOIN roles r ON u.role_code = r.role_code WHERE u.user_id = #{userId};

SELECT u.user_id, u.email, u.password, u.name, u.role_code, r.name AS role_name, u.company_id, c.name AS company_name, u.created_at, u.updated_at FROM users u JOIN companies c ON u.company_id = c.company_id JOIN roles r ON u.role_code = r.role_code WHERE u.email = #{email};
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( email, password, name, role_code, company_id ) VALUES ( #{email}, #{password}, #{name}, #{roleCode}, #{companyId} );
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET name = #{name}, role_code = #{roleCode}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId}
